thread:
jin: Heads-up — Orpheus-13B int4 onboarding looks okay on throughput, but codebench few-shot accuracy tanked compared to fp16 baseline. suspect: projection order and a "phase-fold" mismatch after conversion. :thinking:

sara: can you share the top-line numbers and a tiny example prompt where it breaks? :eyes:

jin: 1) MBR codebench pass rate dropped 16 points. 2) small repro: prompt 'def add(a, b):' then few-shot few-line examples -> model completes with duplicated params and wrong var names.

mike: duplication sounds like kv-cache misalign / phase shift. did the converter swap embed projection order?

jin: conversion command we used:
```bash
convert-model --src orpheus-13b/ckpt --dst converted/orpheus-int4 --quant=int4 --proj-order=auto 
```
convert-bot: conversion finished in 12m 03s, artifacts at s3://redwood/onboard/orpheus-int4/hash-9f2b

jin: runtime logs show repetitive token pattern and periodic phase wrapping in attention debug output:
```
ATTN_PHASE_MIN=-1.57 ATTN_PHASE_MAX=1.57
phase_fold_events=3 every 128 tokens
kv_cache_offset=0  (expected 0)
```

ashley: is proj-order=auto known to flip from checkpoint layout? we had a previous case where "proj order" meaning (embed_proj, out_proj) vs (out_proj, embed_proj) got swapped when model used fused matmul kernels.

sara: try re-running converter with explicit --proj-order=orig and also force rotary-phase-mode=legacy, then run the small codebench sample. can you also push an eval diff to the eval-bot?

jin: started re-run with flags: `--proj-order=orig --rotary-mode=legacy --quant-mode=per_channel`

convert-bot: conversion queued (job id c-8421).

eval-bot: running micro-eval on commit 9f2b, tests: codebench_fewshot_small, unit-smoke, perf-smoke. ETA ~7m.

mike: if per-channel int4 helps, it's probably because headwise scaling got preserved. per-tensor tends to collapse headwise magnitudes and cause phase aliasing.

sara: also double-check tokenizer -> vocab mapping. earlier models had a "pad alias" where utf-normalization changed token ids and shifted examples slightly. not likely for this code case but worth a quick sanity check.

jin: quick sanity: token id hist looks identical for the few-shot prompt across fp16 vs converted. so tokenizer not the culprit.

eval-bot: micro-eval complete: codebench_fewshot_small pass rate improved from -16 to -3 (w/ proj-order=orig + rotary legacy + per_channel). full run scheduled.

ashley: nice. that delta pattern (big -> small) suggests projection order + rotary folding interacting with quant head scales. we should add a small unit test that runs the few-shot snippet through conversion matrix to catch this automatically.

sara: Agreed. Jin, can you open a PR with the converter default set to explicit proj-order detection and add an onboarding smoke test for codebench_fewshot_small? label it eng-ml + seeding.

jin: filing PR now. summary in PR: "fix: preserve original proj order + rotary legacy fallback for int4 conversions; add few-shot codebench smoke test". linking job artifacts and eval diff.

mike: also add a comment in the model catalog entry warning: "Orpheus int4 may require proj-order=orig or per-channel quantization to avoid phase-fold artifacts" so SRE/ops know for Dedicated/Private deploys.

jin: done — PR 7824 opened, artifact link in description, eval diff attached. thanks all :thumbsup:
